# Vocab fixture
brave | adjective | ready to face danger without fear | The brave knight met the dragon.
curious | adj. | wanting to know about something
enormous | adjective | very, very big
gather | verb | to bring together into one place | We gathered leaves into a pile. | Bees gather nectar from flowers. | | This line never uses the word.
examine | v | to look at closely
habitat | noun | the natural home of a plant or animal
journey | noun | a trip from one place to another | The journey took all day.
quickly | adverb | in a fast way | It has no form of the word in it.
gently | adverb | in a soft and careful way
predict | to say what will happen before it happens
shelter | noun
Brave | noun | a duplicate that is ignored
